purpose: Single-image references for generating nine representative 3D car archetypes
background: White, opaque; not an alpha cutout
scale_note: Images are independently framed, not to a common metric scale. Dimensions in prompts describe intended proportions, not measured output dimensions.
limitations: Representative body styles, not exact manufacturer/model replicas.
Single views do not establish hidden-side or rear geometry; inspect generated 3D assets from all sides.
Transporter is one representative panel van; the dataset also contains smaller city vans and larger vans.
These images contain no damage-zone labels or segmentation masks.
Not yet validated through the GPU image-to-3D pipeline.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: clean single-image conditioning reference for image-to-3D reconstruction of a generic car archetype.
Primary request: create ONE photorealistic studio product image of the vehicle described below.
Scene/backdrop: pure uniform white seamless background. No environment, horizon line, floor pattern or props. Only a faint tight contact shadow underneath the tires, no cast shadow extending away.
Composition: landscape 3:2 image, exactly one complete vehicle, centered and filling about 85% of the width, with generous clear margin around every bumper and wheel. Front-left three-quarter view, nose pointing toward the lower-left of the image and rear toward the upper-right. Camera sees mostly the left side plus the front, approximately 25 degrees from a true left-side view toward the nose, slightly elevated enough to see the hood and roof. Long focal length, low perspective distortion. Do not crop any part.
Style: highly realistic clean production-car product rendering, neutral light silver-gray metallic paint, dark gray transparent-looking glass, black rubber tires and simple silver five-spoke wheels. Soft diffuse studio illumination, gentle broad reflections, clearly visible panel gaps and body boundaries.
Constraints: intact undamaged car, straight wheels, all doors and hood closed, conventional physically plausible geometry, four wheels total, two side mirrors, no people. Unbranded generic design, no logos, lettering, watermark, labels or text; blank license plates. No colored damage overlays, no exploded view, no diagram, no collage, no extra views. This image must stand alone as the only input image to a 3D reconstruction system.

assets.revision_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this silver MPV reference image. Correct the passenger door layout to a compact European MPV with FOUR CONVENTIONAL FRONT-HINGED PASSENGER DOORS, two on each side, like the body packaging of a Touran. On the visible left side, keep the front door handle at the rear edge of the front door near the B pillar, but MOVE THE REAR PASSENGER DOOR HANDLE to the REAR EDGE of the rear passenger door, immediately ahead of the rear wheel arch and below the rear of the rear door window. The rear door handle must be well separated from the front door handle, not adjacent to it. Remove any sliding door tracks or sliding-door seams. Retain a tall compact passenger cabin, large windows and upright rear hatch, shorten excessive rear cargo overhang if needed. Preserve the silver paint, white background, photorealistic studio style, front-left three-quarter camera angle, vehicle facing left, complete uncropped body, wheels, light, blank plates and absence of logos. One vehicle, no labels, no text. This is a single image-to-3D reference.
